resources.name: Tele MANAS (Tele Mental Health Assistance and Networking Across States)
resources.source: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare (MoHFW), implemented via NIMHANS Bengaluru
resources.notes: Primary recommended mental-health crisis/support line for India. Two-tier model: Tier 1 counsellors, Tier 2 specialist/psychiatric referral with e-prescription and video consultation where needed.

resources.name: KIRAN Mental Health Rehabilitation Helpline
resources.source: Ministry of Social Justice & Empowerment, Dept. of Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities (DEPwD)
resources.notes: Focused on early screening, first aid, psychological support, and rehabilitation referral -- covers anxiety, OCD, depression, panic attacks, PTSD, substance abuse, and suicidal ideation per its own stated scope. Note: some secondary sources list a conflicting number for KIRAN (1-800-891-4416, which is actually Tele MANAS's alternate number) -- 1800-599-0019 is the number corroborated by the original PIB launch announcement and is used here; flagged for a second independent check before production.

resources.name: National Emergency Number (police / fire / women's safety / integrating ambulance)
resources.source: Ministry of Home Affairs, Emergency Response Support System (ERSS)
resources.notes: General emergency number, not mental-health-specific. Use for immediate physical danger or a crisis requiring police/ambulance dispatch. Rollout was phased by state historically -- confirm current coverage for the patient's specific state if possible.

resources.name: Ambulance / Medical Emergency
resources.notes: Number varies somewhat by state; 108 is the most common. Being integrated into 112 over time per government sources -- flagged source_verification_required to confirm current status per state.
